annotations.title: List rules amending a CFR part

description: Is anything changing in the part of the CFR I am subject to? Give a CFR title and part — "49 CFR 192", "40 CFR 52", "21 CFR 1308" — and get the already-published final rules that amend it, soonest effective date first, with each rule's DATES paragraph and a verbatim quote. The part is matched whole, so "40 CFR 5" never returns rules about 40 CFR 52.

cfr_part.description: The CFR title and part together, e.g. "49 CFR 192". A bare part number is refused: it is ambiguous across the fifty CFR titles.

from.description: Optional ISO date; only rules taking effect on or after it.

name: list_rules_amending_cfr_part

agency.description: The issuing agency as the Federal Register names it.

also_reported.description: Values for this record reported by a SECOND source, each with its own source_url and source_quote. Cite these to the page they name, never to the record's primary source.

cfr_parts.description: The CFR title and part references, e.g. "49 CFR 171, 49 CFR 173". Assembled here from the record's structured cfr_references list, so it is our formatting of the source's values, not a printed string.

dates_paragraph.description: The rule's own DATES paragraph, verbatim. The authority on when it bites.

effective_date.description: ISO date the rule takes effect, from the Federal Register's structured effective_on field. Read dates_paragraph before acting on it.

record_url.description: This record's own page on referencesource.org.

source_quote.description: Verbatim text from that page containing the value.

source_url.description: The page the value was read from.

under_review.description: PRESENT ONLY when a re-reading of this record's own source page states a different value from the one published here. Each named field's value is unsettled and must be cited as disputed, not as the publisher's current position. Absent means no correction is on file for this record — it is never returned empty.

reported_on.description: The date we re-read the page.

reported_value_found_in_that_quote.description: Whether the NEW value was found verbatim inside the new quote. False means the re-reading is not itself quote-confirmed.

title: List rules amending a CFR part
